steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with the stated bids and buyer context.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Enter the invalid alphabetic quantity in the recreated order.
Verify that the Quantity Requested cell does not retain the letters.
